title: Credential Guard or memory integrity is not enforced

messages.businessImpact: Credentials held in memory can be harvested from a compromised device and reused elsewhere, which is how a single infected laptop becomes a domain-wide incident.
remediation: Enable Credential Guard and memory integrity through an endpoint security policy.
Test on each hardware model first, since older drivers can prevent memory integrity from starting.
messages.cannotSee: Whether an assigned policy switches these on is read, not whether a device could run them: both need virtualisation support and firmware settings that older hardware does not have, so a tenant with a correct policy can still have devices without the protection. The endpoint security policies and the Settings Catalog profiles are read together, because either can set them, but a setting this tool has no mapping for is not looked for at all and the rule is then not applicable rather than raised. A policy that sets them and reaches nobody counts as enforcing nothing.
